name: radio-group
title: Radio group
summary: Picks exactly one option from two to six that are all worth reading.
use: When people should compare every option. For more options use a select; for two or three short ones in a toolbar, a segmented control.
anatomy: Options: a circle, a label and an optional description
rules: Always start with one option picked when there is a sensible default.
Each choice is an inset well; the picked one holds a raised ink dot.
